description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'SavingsAccountsApiResource' for handling operations related to savings accounts in a financial application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and performing various actions on savings accounts, such as applying commands (approve, activate, close, block, unblock), retrieving templates, and handling bulk import/export templates.

classes.name: SavingsAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing API endpoints for managing savings accounts, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, command execution (e.g., approve, activate), and bulk import/export functionalities.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account template with default values, allowed values, and other metadata to assist in building client UI.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of savings accounts with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Creates a new savings account application based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: submitGSIMApplication
methods.description: Creates a new G-SIM savings account application based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific savings account by account ID or external ID, including associations and charge status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies details of a savings account or application based on account ID or external ID and command parameter.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Executes various commands on a savings account, such as approve, activate, close, block, or unblock, based on command parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Hard deletes a savings account if it is in 'submitted and pending approval' state.

methods.name: getSavingsTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk creating savings accounts.

methods.name: postSavingsTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an Excel template for bulk import of savings accounts.

methods.name: getSavingsTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Downloads a template for bulk upload of savings transactions.

methods.name: postSavingsTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Uploads a bulk savings transaction Excel file.
